limitations: Previously reviewed games; not unseen or independent validation.

Legacy setup/camera abstentions are not current-protocol visibility negatives.

Point labels provide neither bounding boxes nor segmentation masks.
Post-hoc selected condensed-video frames cannot establish pre-pitch availability.
COCO glove class includes pitcher/other-player gloves.
No current-protocol confirmed negatives or bbox/mask labels; no false-positive rate, AP/IoU or general accuracy claim.
